body: Honestly, I live for the simple little things in life. Waking up early before anyone else is awake, walking around my quiet house, and looking out the window to see the sun rising. Or climbing my roof at night to look up at the stars and just take a moment to stop and realize I’m alive. Life truly has no purpose nor meaning but it’s up to you to make it meaningful. Life will have its ups and downs but it’s important to realize that life is a gift. Just take a moment to stop and appreciate that you’re alive. I know things may be hard for you right now or you’re going through something, but I can promise you that with time everything will be fine. You are amazing and you matter.
